system.description:
Play the Spy if you want to manipulate and strike when your enemies least expect it.

Features

Pull the Strings. When you reveal a secret about someone or blackmail them during a scene, they must pass a Reaction Roll (15) or become Compromised until the end of the scene. While Compromised, they are Vulnerable and must mark a Stress when they take the spotlight.

No Loose Ends. Once per Rest, you may immediately perform an Ambush against a Compromised target. This attack deals damage even on a miss, but on a hit, it becomes a critical hit.
